messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #19920 needs to land before the feature-flag rollout tomorrow (11:00 PT). CI is queued and we have a deploy freeze at 13:00 PT. Can we get quick reviews or a rebase window?
Sarah: On it, I'll do a pass now. @Ben can you take e2e? :eyes:
Ben: I can handle e2e but CI is flaky on mac-matrix today. CI-Bot shows two failing tests: integration::schema_lock.
CI-Bot: Build #5821 failed: integration/schema_lock on mac-latest. Logs: https://ci.internal/5821
Alex: Thanks — @Priya do we have a rebase slot? I can rebase to address that lint break in the last commit.
Priya: We have a 30m rebase window at 09:30 PT (tomorrow). If you can land by 11:30 PT we should be safe before the freeze, but capacity is limited so aim earlier.
Sarah: Leaving review comments now — mostly nits. Approvals pending e2e and a quick security scan.
Ben: I'll run the e2e locally to try to unblock. If CI stays flakey, can we request a manual canary deploy? @DeployBot any constraints?
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy freeze at 13:00 PT — merges after 12:30 PT will be blocked. Manual canaries require SRE signoff; please ping #eng-oncall for exceptions.
Priya: SRE oncall is listed in #eng-oncall. If you need a canary, ping them and include the test results and rollback plan.
Alex: Rebase done and pushed: `git rebase origin/main` -> force-pushed. Triggering CI rerun: `ci rerun --pr=19920`.
CI-Bot: Rerun queued (build #5823).
Ben: Local e2e passed. Watching CI; if green I'll approve quickly.
Sarah: Approved after nits fixed. :thumbsup:
CI-Bot: All checks passed on build #5823. Merge queue position: 2. Estimated land time 10:50 PT.
Alex: Thanks everyone — merging now to avoid the freeze window. I'll monitor canary and post updates here if anything odd shows up.
